title: CITRAS-FM (7M-param, CPU) zero-shot vol/regime forecast as a feature vs the LightGBM vol head (ts_foundation_model family)

frontier.baseline: the existing LightGBM vol/regime head (or realized-vol persistence) on identical rows, net-of-cost consumer read as the decision
frontier.blocking: a loader + package for CITRAS-FM weights (licence to read first; HF hitachi-* repo per metadata) and a zero-shot vol-forecast feature block in ml_bakeoff
frontier.consumer: the 15m/1h vol-regime heads that feed trend_vol OFF-cells (config/regime_policy.yaml) or the ml_entry vol features
frontier.next_step: read the model card + licence; if usable, build the loader as an opt-in ml_bakeoff feature block and author a unit vs the LightGBM vol head
frontier.source: CITRAS-FM arXiv 2606.10798 (PRIMARY abstract: 7M params, covariate-informed zero-shot, sub-0.1 s CPU inference); negative prior for returns from 2606.27100 (TSFM gains over random walk small/sparse, DM rejects 2/10)
frontier.why: ts_foundation_model has 0 open plan items; this is the first TSFM that is CPU-feasible on our runners/trainer; aim it at vol/regime (where persistence is real), not returns
